structure: Part 5, Identification details. Read in full: the 'identification details' describe block of prototype-specs/e2e/description-of-the-goods.fit.spec.js (lines 189-323) and of snagging.fit.spec.js (lines 262-301), with their set-up helpers, and mined all 10 traces the part names, every action of each: cattle (115 actions; first animal, no-identifier error, second animal, all saved, remove, continue), horse, cat and pig (about 60 actions each; first panel only), poultry (66; one flock panel), germinal products (85; first view, three-error submit, valid submit), and snagging S15 (one animal saved), S16 (desktop, mobile 390x844 and no-JS contexts, before and after one animal saved), S17 (one animal saved, desktop, mobile and no-JS) and S18 (both animals saved). Every trace walks the opening run (create-notification, origin, what are you importing, reason, commodity details; germinal also total gross weight) to reach /design-release-2.1/animal-identification-details, which is the one page this part claims; the opening pages belong to other parts. Pages and order: commodity details (/consignment-details) then identification details for live animals; commodity details then total gross weight then identification details for germinal products; identification details then /additional-animal-details (cattle) or /arrival-details (germinal). The page has one fixed layout: notification status bar, caption, h1, inset, a 'Selected commodities' grid, an 'Add another commodity' link, then one section per commodity holding one grey-headed panel per species, then the form actions. What is conditional: the caption (live animals vs germinal), the summary's count column, the change-count link wording, the identifiers asked for (by species), whether animals are entered one at a time with a counter (cattle, horse, cat, pig) or in one panel (poultry, germinal), the button on the panel (Save and add another, then Save and finish on the last animal) and the saved animals table (appears below the entry form once one animal is saved; the form goes once all are saved). Evidence was read from DOM snapshots with eval (main innerText, outerHTML, inputs, hints, error summary, computed styles) and from the network log of the cattle trace. Trace refs below give the zip name without its folder (workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/traces-prototype/) and the action id the snapshot was taken at. Snapshots render at 1280px wide, so the mobile screenshots of S16 and S17 could not be measured.

claims.statement: No poultry validation was exercised: whether any poultry field is required, and the errors for an invalid hatching date or no identifier, are not shown. Nor is what a saved flock looks like.
No germinal submit with empty fields was exercised, so which germinal fields are required, and their messages, are not shown.

'Save and return to overview', 'Cancel and return to overview', the selected commodities 'Change' link and 'Add another commodity' were never clicked on this page, so where they lead and what they save is only what their markup says.
Whether identifier values are checked for format or length (ear tag, passport, microchip) is not shown: only the empty case was refused for live animals.
